exposure: Pregnancy scenario (uneventful, normal under their care, general population, own/partner's delivery)
outcome: Preferred mode of delivery (vaginal vs. cesarean)
cohort: 292 medical students (150 first-year, 142 internship) at Maharashtra Institute of Medical Education and Research, India
finding: Most students preferred vaginal delivery, but internship students were more likely to prefer cesarean section for their own or their partner's delivery.
mod_finding: The student's preference for childbirth changed in due course of graduation toward cesarean section.
